entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Catalyst] WebView does not display ContextFlyout on right-click #30308
  • ScrollView changes the size of buttons on iOS #30305
  • Extract copilot instructions from https://github.com/dotnet/maui/pull/30300 #30303

Closed

  • [Repo] Remove the need for node when build Maui solution #30104
    Backlog
  • MAUI app template not found #30301
  • [copilot] Create a PR with just the updated copilot instructions from PR 30291 #30297

Created

    platform/macos, community ✨, area-controls-contextmenu

    area-testing, community ✨, area-controls-border, partner/syncfusion

    community ✨, area-controls-entry, partner/syncfusion

    p/0, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, .NET 9 SR9
